component.name: CompactRow
component.script:
sub init() m.headerLabel = m.top.FindNode("headerLabel") m.titleLabel = m.top.FindNode("titleLabel") m.durationLabel = m.top.FindNode("durationLabel") m.dateLabel = m.top.FindNode("dateLabel") m.focusOutline = m.top.FindNode("focusOutline") m.top.observeField("itemContent.rowFocused", "onRowFocusedChanged") end sub
sub onRowFocusedChanged() content = m.top.itemContent if content <> invalid m.focusOutline.visible = content.rowFocused end if end sub
sub onContentChanged() content = m.top.itemContent if content = invalid then return
m.focusOutline.visible = content.rowFocused
if content.layoutMode = "standard" m.headerLabel.visible = false m.durationLabel.visible = false m.dateLabel.visible = false m.titleLabel.visible = true m.titleLabel.width = 660 m.titleLabel.text = content.title else if content.isHeader = true m.headerLabel.visible = true m.headerLabel.text = content.title m.titleLabel.visible = false m.durationLabel.visible = false m.dateLabel.visible = false else if content.layoutMode = "grouped" m.headerLabel.visible = false m.durationLabel.visible = false m.dateLabel.visible = false m.titleLabel.visible = true m.titleLabel.width = 660 m.titleLabel.text = content.title else m.headerLabel.visible = false m.titleLabel.visible = true m.titleLabel.width = 510 m.titleLabel.text = content.title
if content.durationSeconds <> invalid and content.durationSeconds > 0 m.durationLabel.visible = true secs = content.durationSeconds hrs = Int(secs / 3600) remaining = secs - (hrs * 3600) mins = Int(remaining / 60) s = remaining - (mins * 60) if hrs > 0 durStr = hrs.ToStr() + ":" + Right("0" + mins.ToStr(), 2) + ":" + Right("0" + s.ToStr(), 2) else durStr = mins.ToStr() + ":" + Right("0" + s.ToStr(), 2) end if m.durationLabel.text = durStr else m.durationLabel.visible = false end if
if content.uploadDate <> invalid and content.uploadDate <> "" m.dateLabel.visible = true m.dateLabel.text = content.uploadDate else m.dateLabel.visible = false end if end if end sub
